title: party
description: An organisation taking part in the model, such as a partner company or a client. Lanes in a swimlane are grouped by party.

id.description: Unique id: lower-case letters and numbers joined by hyphens, e.g. acme.

summary.description: One or two sentences about this party.

brand.description: Optional id of a brand pack in brands/<id>/, e.g. acme. The party is then shown with that brand's colour and mark. Left out, it gets a neutral colour and its initials.

status.description: How this element differs from today.

today.description: How it works today, shown next to the future state.
